required.description: States that the later implementation binds to the published fact set through FACT_SET_ID. Missing determination does not block facts reads.
Recommends reuse of the recorded snapshot without another provider run or reconstruction solely to satisfy the old report requirement.
Keeps company authorization and original artifact integrity checks. Does not substitute the latest fact set implicitly.
Explains that report access can still fail when the snapshot has no completed determination.
Uses the later successful replay as historical evidence and calls for checking the current checkout and snapshot before claiming present readiness.

prohibited.description: Treats the old shared determination requirement as unresolved and recommends implementing the already-completed decoupling without checking the checkout.
Requires a new determination/provider run merely to make the saved facts readable.
Claims a successful current launch, hosted authentication, or clean launcher exit based only on historical excerpts.

pass_rule: All required criteria must pass and no prohibited behavior may occur. Report each criterion separately.
execution_rule: Grade advice and supported historical claims. Do not award credit for claimed live execution.
